digest.component_or_area: test suite organization / regression oracle validation
propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property fails to detect two fault classes (F3: shape-valid empty payload; F6: incomplete record) that the original show regression test catches, because the generic stops at shape validation while the original adds content completeness assertions

Reverting the slim-fetch-ledge fix leaves both burst tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect the original 15s timeout regression, proving the burst test does not protect against the regression it is named for

The storm-based tests (T2, T3) are unreliable oracles for the specific race condition due to probabilistic nature across only 48 iterations, consistent with established OSS practice showing storms are weak mutation detectors
Both test files are complements rather than duplicates: F5 (35s stall) and F7 (empty list output) are caught only by the generic property, while F3/F6 are caught only by the original

Safe test removal requires mutation/fault-seeding verification that deletion does not decrease fault detection score; this matrix proves deletion of T2 would forfeit F3/F6 coverage, exceeding the criterion threshold for removal

Measured wall-clock times confirm the 10.95-22.63s CI range (Ubuntu 12.79-14.93s, macOS 15.34s); the 8.2-8.8s local runtime saving from removal is not available because the test remains necessary for completeness detection
